# JetBrains Marketplace plugins

<!-- Generated by tools/clientrecipes from src/jetbrainsplugins.json; edit the source. -->

Read the [common setup and credential rules](README.md) first. [All recipes](index.md).

Client: **IntelliJ IDEA 2026.2.4**. Registered classes: **remote**.

Endpoint: `${AW_URL}/artifactory/api/jetbrainsplugins/${AW_REPO}`

## Before connecting

- Remote jetbrainsplugins repository with a compatible Marketplace upstream.
- Administrator-approved anonymous read access.
- AW_PLUGIN_ID is the plugin XML ID of an upstream plugin compatible with the pinned IDEA client listed above. The controlled fixture uses com.weave.fixture; it is not a public plugin.

Authentication: The tested native IDE uses a repository with explicit anonymous READ authorization. It does not send AW_TOKEN. Anonymous access must be enabled and permission granted by an administrator; the endpoint still returns 401 before that grant.

Fresh client state: Set IDEA_PROPERTIES to a newly created properties file whose config, system, plugins and log paths are distinct empty directories under AW_WORK.

## Configure

```sh
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
export IDEA_PROPERTIES="$AW_WORK/idea.properties"
cat > "$IDEA_PROPERTIES" <<EOF
idea.plugins.host=$AW_URL/artifactory/api/jetbrainsplugins/$AW_REPO
idea.config.path=$AW_WORK/config
idea.system.path=$AW_WORK/system
idea.plugins.path=$AW_WORK/plugins
idea.log.path=$AW_WORK/log
EOF
```

## Publish

No supported command. Remote-only repository; publishing a plugin to the upstream Marketplace is outside this service.

## Install or resolve

Classes: **remote**. The real IDE resolves compatibility and installs the archive.

```sh
idea.sh installPlugins "$AW_PLUGIN_ID"
```

## Limits

Classes outside **remote** are not registered for this format. Commands above apply only to each operation's listed classes. Federated evidence is for one node; it does not establish cross-vendor replication.

- Only the remote class is supported.
- Keep the custom Marketplace host separate from the ordinary IDE user profile.
- REST authentication support does not imply the native IDE can supply repository tokens.
